subject: Continue the DomainSpec architecture ontology from candidate model to real-source evidence
why_now: Commit 2cbb0f16 is now available on origin/master as a self-contained candidate ontology experiment with a validated canvas and beginner guide. The next owner can continue from a stable evidence baseline, but must preserve the remaining real-source and human-comprehension proof gaps.
key_points: Commit 2cbb0f164eb1625995e32c2c5f1e6dff6e66c7a7 added the 19-file ontology experiment to origin/master without changing canonical DS-D1 definitions or any submodule pointer.

A clean archive of the committed tree passed 19 ontology checks, resolved all seven digest-bound sources, and reproduced exactly eight expected findings for the deliberately broken TypeScript fixture.

The DS-D1 projection preserves 24 staged labels plus the superseded Saga tombstone and gives every active backend meta-type an explicit disposition: five candidate-mapped, two profiled-unmapped, and six unsupported.

The interactive canvas and dependency-free beginner reader passed local Chromium checks with zero console errors and zero failed requests; the guide separates semantic type, implementation type, profile, supplied fact, finding, and owner action.
The current observed fact graph is hand-authored. No TypeScript, Python, Rust, compiler, module-resolution, architecture-provider, or runtime adapter produced these facts.
The explanation transport remains flag rather than pass because no representative beginner has yet confirmed comprehension.

open_calls.owner: Representative beginner reader and documentation owner
open_calls.question: Can a newcomer use the guide and canvas to distinguish DomainSpec meaning, candidate implementation shape, profile expectation, supplied evidence, findings, and authority without assistance?
What bounded TypeScript AST and module-resolution adapter contract can emit the existing ObservationProjection shape while reporting indeterminate constructs as typed unsupported evidence?
Which non-normative data source should own plain-language concept and property copy so the ontology, canvas, and beginner guide cannot silently drift?

boundaries: This notice and locator are communication evidence only; they do not select a task, grant execution authority, approve a profile, promote a type, or authorize release or deployment.
Keep canonical DS-D1 identity and maturity under definitions-governance. The local projection and all candidate mappings retain authority_effect none.

Do not infer semantic identity from filename, folder, callable form, boolean return shape, or matching English labels. In particular, deferred DS-D1.24 Adapter is not mapped to architecture.AdapterImplementation.
Do not describe fixture facts as source-extracted evidence. Missing, dynamic, or indeterminate adapter evidence must become typed unsupported evidence rather than an accidental pass.
Keep portable properties separate from TypeScript, Python, Rust, and project-specific profile choices; arrow-function is a TypeScript profile expectation, not the meaning of Rule.
Static architecture findings do not prove runtime correctness, effect delivery, semantic admission, accessibility acceptance, production readiness, or remote deployment.

next_actions.owner: Representative beginner reader and documentation owner
next_actions.action: Run a short comprehension review using the ten-minute learning path and record misunderstandings without changing canonical definitions.
Author and select a bounded plan for a TypeScript observation adapter that reuses the committed fact schema and deterministic evaluator.
After explicit plan selection, implement the TypeScript AST and module-resolution slice against real positive, negative, and unsupported fixtures.
Decide a single non-normative owner for explanatory copy before adding more generated views or language surfaces.
